title: רמי בר רב
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Heilprin records Rami bar Rav in Rav’s name at Shabbat 32b and Makkot 23b. The checked Shabbat gives both Rav and Hama as patronymics. Makkot gives Rami bar Rav as the speaker. See above, Rami bar Hama.
